name: cg_exchange_rates
description:
Bitcoin exchange rates against fiat currencies, other crypto assets and commodities, from CoinGecko (exchange_rates).
Returns {rates: {code: {name, unit, value (units per 1 BTC), type (fiat | crypto | commodity)}}}.
Inputs: none.
For a coin's price in a given currency use cg_coin_price.
Example: {}
